AC's done for the year. Here's the one thing to do before winter. ❄️

Fairfield County homeowners: cover the top of your condenser so leaves and ice stay out, but don't wrap the whole thing. Trapped moisture rusts it from the inside. A simple tarp does it.

Send this to someone whose AC is still uncovered.
